query: Cheapest large soy candle available, any scent, just need it to last a long time.

products.title: Soy Candle
products.description: Elevate your relaxation with the Girl's Night In Large Soy Candle from Matt & Nat. This warm and ethereal candle features a Pink Champagne scent, blending creamy powdery heliotrope with lush garden roses to create a sophisticated atmosphere. Housed in a frosted glass jar with a removable bamboo logo embossed lid, it is crafted from a blend of 95% soy and 5% paraffin wax. This vegan and cruelty-free candle offers up to 32 hours of burn time, making it a sustainable choice for your home wellness routine.
key_features: Frosted glass jar with removable bamboo lid

products.title: Wellness Soy Candle

This eco-friendly candle provides up to 55 hours of burn time and comes in a beautiful, gift-ready presentation, making it ideal for home fragrance, self-care routines, or gifting.

Perfect for home fragrance, self-care & gifting

products.title: Soy Candle
products.description: Transport yourself to a cozy corner of your local cafe with the Coffee Shop soy candle. This inviting scent features top notes of coffee, sweet cream, and coffee in the middle, grounded by a warm base of vanilla and chocolate. Hand-poured in small batches in St. Augustine, FL, this 8 oz candle is crafted from natural soy wax with organic cotton wicks, ensuring a clean, vegan, and phthalate-free burn for approximately 45 hours.
key_features: Scent notes: Coffee, Sweet Cream, Vanilla, and Chocolate

products.title: Honey Horchata Soy Candle
products.description: A sweet and comforting soy candle with a fragrance profile featuring honeyed rice, creamy vanilla, and cinnamon. Hand-poured in the USA, this candle provides a cozy aroma reminiscent of fresh waffle cones at an ice cream shop. key_features: Scent notes of Rice, Vanilla, and Cinnamon

products.title: The Hamptons Soy Candle & Fragrance Diffuser
products.description: A luxury fragrance set featuring 'The Hamptons' scent by Glasshouse. This bundle includes a 7.05 oz (208 ml) soy wax candle in a clear glass jar and a 5.07 oz (150 ml) fragrance diffuser, designed to bring a sophisticated aroma to any living space.

products.title: Bouquet Soy Candle
products.description: The Woolzies Bouquet Soy Candle is an all-natural aromatherapy candle designed to fill your space with a beautiful floral fragrance of Rose and Jasmine essential oils. The candle is vegan, paraben-free, and cruelty-free, ensuring a high-quality sensory experience that is welcoming and gentle.
